slides.title: Prefix vs Postfix Increment
slides.prompt: How is the postfix increment operator syntax differentiated from prefix increment in custom iterator classes?
options: Postfix increment accepts a dummy int parameter: operator++(int)
Postfix increment returns a reference type T&
Postfix increment is defined using operator+
slides.correctAnswer: Postfix increment accepts a dummy int parameter: operator++(int)

slides.title: Writing Custom Generic Algorithms
slides.prompt: What template parameter design best practice ensures custom algorithms work across different STL containers?
options: Accept generic template iterator parameters (InputIt, ForwardIt) rather than specific container types
Use void* raw pointers for efficiency

slides.title: std::iterator Deprecation
slides.prompt: Why was base class std::iterator deprecated in C++17?
options: It added unnecessary boilerplate and inheritance complexity; defining nested types or using C++20 concepts is cleaner
It caused memory leaks in virtual destructors
It was incompatible with template compilation
Iterators are no longer supported in C++
slides.correctAnswer: It added unnecessary boilerplate and inheritance complexity; defining nested types or using C++20 concepts is cleaner
